title: Relay
subtitle: Your image and video studio. Ask Claude to create and edit; watch the results here.

connect.title: Use Relay from Claude
connect.description: Relay's image and video tools work in any MCP client. While Relay is running, add it once:

images.emptyDescription: Ask Claude something like "make a 1080×1350 poster for my bakery" or "open ~/Pictures/me.jpg and warm it up".

videos.emptyDescription: Ask Claude something like "cut ~/Movies/trip.mov into a 15 s vertical video with a title".
